pyq_focus: NET mein Unit 7 se sabse zyada 'author-book match' aata hai: Williams - Culture and Society, Hoggart - The Uses of Literacy, Thompson - The Making of the English Working Class.
Stuart Hall ka 'Encoding/Decoding' aur teen reading positions (dominant, negotiated, oppositional) baar baar pucha gaya hai.
Raymond Williams ke terms: 'structure of feeling', 'culture is ordinary', dominant-residual-emergent, cultural materialism (Dollimore-Sinfield) yaad rakho.
Frankfurt School: Adorno-Horkheimer 'Culture Industry' (Dialectic of Enlightenment), Benjamin 'aura' aur mechanical reproduction - match questions mein favourite.
Gramsci ka hegemony aur organic intellectual, Althusser ka ISA/RSA aur interpellation - assertion-reason type mein aate hain.
Barthes (Mythologies, myth as second-order signification), Baudrillard (simulacra, hyperreality), Bourdieu (habitus, cultural capital, Distinction) ke terms pakko.
Subaltern Studies (Ranajit Guha, Spivak 'Can the Subaltern Speak?'), ecocriticism (Glotfelty, Buell, Garrard) aur queer theory (Butler, Sedgwick) bhi aate hain.
Chronology questions ke liye saal yaad karo: 1957 Hoggart, 1958 Williams, 1963 Thompson, 1964 CCCS, 1972 Cohen Folk Devils, 1979 Hebdige Subculture.
Tayyari: har thinker ka ek book + ek key term + ek saal ka chhota card banao aur roz revise karo.

easy.title: Background: From Arnold and Leavis to Cultural Studies
easy.story: Pehle Matthew Arnold bolte the ki culture matlab 'the best that has been thought and said' - yaani sirf bade log ki oonchi cheezein. F. R. Leavis bhi kehte the ki ek chhoti 'minority' hi asli culture bachati hai, aur mass culture kharab hai. Socho mummy kehti hai sirf classical music achha hai, filmi gaane bekaar. Phir Cultural Studies wale aaye aur bole: nahi bhai, gali ka gaana, TV, cricket - sab culture hai. Isse 'high culture vs popular culture' ki deewar tooti.
easy.trick: A-L-W: Arnold (1869 Culture and Anarchy) - Leavis (1930 Mass Civilization and Minority Culture) - Williams ('culture is ordinary'). Oonchi seedhi se zameen tak!

easy.title: Birmingham CCCS (Centre for Contemporary Cultural Studies)
easy.story: 1964 mein Birmingham University mein ek chhota sa centre bana - CCCS. Iske pehle director Richard Hoggart the, phir Stuart Hall aaye. Yahan log TV, punk, school ke ladke, akhbaar sab ko padhte the jaise koi kitab padhta hai. Socho ek kamra jahan sab mohalle ki baatein seriously discuss hoti hain. 2002 mein ye department band ho gaya.
easy.trick: 64 mein Birmingham ka 'Chai Club' khula: Hoggart ne chai banayi, Hall ne serve ki, 2002 mein dukaan band.

easy.title: Richard Hoggart and E. P. Thompson
easy.story: Hoggart ne 1957 mein 'The Uses of Literacy' likhi - working class ki zindagi aur unpar sasti magazines ka asar. E. P. Thompson ne 1963 mein 'The Making of the English Working Class' likhi. Thompson kehte the class koi cheez nahi, ek 'happening' hai jo log khud banate hain. Jaise gaon ke log milke khud apni panchayat banate hain, koi upar se nahi deta. Thompson ne 'history from below' ko famous kiya.
easy.trick: Hoggart = 57 = 'Literacy' (L for Lettering). Thompson = 63 = 'Making' (M after L). Class is 'made', not 'found'.

easy.title: Raymond Williams and Cultural Materialism
easy.story: Raymond Williams ek Welsh railway signalman ke bete the. Unhone kaha 'Culture is ordinary' - culture sabka hai, sirf amiron ka nahi. Unki books: Culture and Society (1958), The Long Revolution (1961), Keywords (1976), Marxism and Literature (1977). 'Structure of feeling' matlab kisi zamane ka common mood, jaise 90s ke bachchon ka Doordarshan wala feeling. Unhone dominant, residual, emergent culture ki baat ki.
easy.trick: Williams ki 'DRE-ss': Dominant, Residual, Emergent. Aur 'Keywords' 76 mein - 'Key 76'.

easy.title: Stuart Hall
easy.story: Stuart Hall Jamaica se England aaye aur CCCS ke acting director (1968) aur phir director (1972-1979) bane. Unka famous essay 'Encoding/Decoding' (1973) kehta hai ki TV message bhejta hai, par dekhne wala apne tareeke se samajhta hai. Jaise papa news dekh ke khush, chacha naraz - same news, alag reading. Teen tarah ki reading: dominant (maan liya), negotiated (aadha maana), oppositional (bilkul ulta). 'Policing the Crisis' (1978) mein mugging ke moral panic ko samjhaya.
easy.trick: Hall ki 'DNO' reading: Dominant, Negotiated, Oppositional - 'Do Na O'!

easy.title: Youth Subcultures, Style and Moral Panics
easy.story: Punk, Mods, Rockers, Teddy Boys - ye youth groups apne kapde, baal aur music se 'style' dikhate the. Dick Hebdige ne 'Subculture: The Meaning of Style' (1979) mein kaha ye style ek tarah ka virodh hai, 'bricolage' se bana. Stanley Cohen ne 'Folk Devils and Moral Panics' (1972) mein dikhaya ki media chhoti baat ko bada darr bana deta hai. Jaise news channel bole 'PUBG se bachche bigad rahe hain!' - wahi moral panic.
easy.trick: Cohen 72 ke 'Devils', Hebdige 79 ka 'Style'. 'Resistance Through Rituals' 1975 - R-R ke beech mein.

easy.title: Frankfurt School and the Culture Industry
easy.story: Germany ke Frankfurt mein kuch Marxist thinker the - Adorno, Horkheimer, Marcuse. Adorno-Horkheimer ne 'Dialectic of Enlightenment' (1944/1947) mein 'Culture Industry' ki baat ki. Matlab filmein, gaane factory jaise ek jaise maal ki tarah bante hain aur logon ko chup karate hain. Jaise har TV serial mein same saas-bahu drama. Marcuse ne 'One-Dimensional Man' (1964) likhi.
easy.trick: Frankfurt ke 'AHM' chacha: Adorno, Horkheimer, Marcuse - sab bole 'Culture Industry = Factory'.

easy.title: Walter Benjamin
easy.story: Walter Benjamin ne 1936 mein essay likha 'The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction'. Unhone kaha asli painting mein ek 'aura' hoti hai - uski unique jagah aur samay. Jab photo copy, poster, film banti hai to aura khatam ho jaati hai. Jaise Taj Mahal khud dekhna aur uska fridge magnet - feel alag. Par Benjamin ko isme democracy bhi dikhi, kyunki sab tak art pahunchi. Unhone 'flâneur' aur 'Arcades Project' bhi diya.
easy.trick: Benjamin = 'Aura Uncle' 1936: copy machine aayi, aura gayi.

easy.title: Antonio Gramsci and Hegemony
easy.story: Gramsci Italy ke Marxist the jinhe Mussolini ne jail mein daala. Jail mein unhone 'Prison Notebooks' likhi. Hegemony matlab ruling class danda nahi, logon ki 'consent' (sehmati) se raaj karti hai. Jaise ad dekh ke hum khud maan lete hain ki gora rang achha - kisi ne zabardasti nahi ki. Unhone 'organic intellectual' aur 'subaltern' word bhi diya.
easy.trick: Gramsci = G for 'Gentle rule' = Hegemony by consent, not by danda.

easy.title: Louis Althusser and Ideological State Apparatuses
easy.story: Althusser French Marxist the. 1970 ke essay 'Ideology and Ideological State Apparatuses' mein do tarah ki machine batayi. RSA - police, army, court, jo force se chalate hain. ISA - school, family, church, media, jo ideology se chalate hain. 'Interpellation' matlab jab policewala bole 'Oye, tum!' aur tum mud jao - tum subject ban gaye.
easy.trick: RSA = Rifle wali (force), ISA = Idea wali (school, family). 'Hey you!' = interpellation.

easy.title: Roland Barthes: Mythologies and Semiology
easy.story: Barthes French thinker the. 'Mythologies' (1957) mein wrestling, soap powder, wine jaisi roz ki cheezon ko padha. Unhone kaha myth ek 'second-order' meaning hai - pehle sign, phir uspe naya chhupa meaning. Famous example: Paris Match cover par French uniform mein kala sipahi salute karta hai, matlab 'French empire sabke liye achha'. Jaise cricket jersey sirf kapda nahi, deshbhakti ka sign. 1967 mein 'The Death of the Author' likha.
easy.trick: Barthes ka 'saluting soldier' = myth. Mythologies 57 - Hoggart ke saath same saal!

easy.title: Baudrillard, Simulation and Postmodern Media Theory
easy.story: Jean Baudrillard ne 'Simulacra and Simulation' (1981) likhi. Unhone kaha aaj copy itni zyada hai ki asli cheez gayab ho gayi - isse 'hyperreality' kehte hain. Disneyland unka famous example hai. Jaise Instagram filter wala chehra asli chehre se zyada 'real' lagne lage. Unhone provocatively kaha 'The Gulf War Did Not Take Place' (1991).

easy.title: Pierre Bourdieu: Taste, Capital and Field
easy.story: Bourdieu French sociologist the. 'Distinction' (1979) mein dikhaya ki taste (pasand) class se aata hai. Unhone capital ke prakar bataye: economic, cultural, social, symbolic. 'Habitus' matlab ghar aur parvarish se bani aadatein, jaise khana chammach se ya haath se. 'Field' matlab ek khel ka maidan jahan log capital ke liye ladte hain.
easy.trick: Bourdieu ke 'HCF': Habitus, Capital, Field. Taste = class ka chashma.

easy.title: John Fiske and Popular Culture Studies
easy.story: John Fiske ne 'Television Culture' (1987) aur 'Understanding Popular Culture' (1989) likhi. Unhone kaha audience bewakoof nahi, active hai - apna meaning khud banata hai. Jaise ek ad ko hum mazaak bana ke meme bana dete hain. Unhone 'semiotic democracy' aur 'polysemy' ki baat ki. Kuch critics ne inhe 'cultural populism' ka example bola.
easy.trick: Fiske = 'Fun-ske': popular culture fun hai, audience active.

easy.title: Subaltern Studies
easy.story: Subaltern matlab neeche dabaye gaye log - kisan, dalit, adivasi, auratein. Ranajit Guha ne 1982 mein Subaltern Studies group shuru kiya, jo itihas ko neeche se dekhna chahta tha. Gayatri Spivak ne puchha 'Can the Subaltern Speak?' aur kaha ki dabe hue log ki awaaz koi aur bol deta hai. Jaise gaon ki kahani hamesha zamindar sunata hai, kisan nahi. Word Gramsci se aaya.
easy.trick: Guha 82 ne group shuru kiya, Spivak ne sawaal puchha: 'Bol sakta hai kya?'

easy.title: Gender, Sexuality and Queer Theory in Cultural Studies
easy.story: Judith Butler ne 'Gender Trouble' (1990) mein kaha gender ek 'performance' hai - hum roz dohraake usse banate hain. Jaise ladkon ko bolna 'ladke rote nahi' - ye baar baar dohraake gender banta hai. Eve Sedgwick ne 'Epistemology of the Closet' (1990) likhi. Laura Mulvey ne 1975 mein 'male gaze' diya - film mein camera aadmi ki nazar se dekhta hai. Teresa de Lauretis ne 'queer theory' term popular kiya (1990/91).
easy.trick: 1990 = Butler + Sedgwick ka 'Queer saal'. Mulvey 75 = 'Male gaze'.

easy.title: Ecocriticism
easy.story: Ecocriticism matlab literature ko prakriti aur paryavaran ke nazariye se padhna. William Rueckert ne 1978 mein 'ecocriticism' word banaya. Cheryll Glotfelty ne kaha ye 'literature aur physical environment ka rishta' hai (The Ecocriticism Reader, 1996). Jaise Ganga par kavita ko pollution ke angle se padhna. Lawrence Buell, Greg Garrard, Jonathan Bate bhi naam hain; India mein Amitav Ghosh ki 'The Great Derangement' (2016).
easy.trick: Rueckert 78 ne naam diya, Glotfelty 96 ne Reader diya - 'R-G' = Ret aur Ghaas.

easy.title: Digital Culture, New Media and Indian Cultural Studies
easy.story: Marshall McLuhan ne kaha 'The medium is the message' (Understanding Media, 1964) aur 'global village' ki baat ki. Henry Jenkins ne 'Convergence Culture' (2006) aur fans ki participatory culture samjhayi. Donna Haraway ne 'A Cyborg Manifesto' (1985) likha. India mein Ashis Nandy, Partha Chatterjee jaise log culture ko apne nazariye se padhte hain. Jaise WhatsApp family group - naya digital culture!

quotes.quote: Culture ... the best which has been thought and said in the world.
Culture is ordinary: that is the first fact.
Culture is one of the two or three most complicated words in the English language.
A culture is a whole way of life.
I do not see class as a structure, nor even as a category, but as something which in fact happens ... in human relationships.
quotes.source: The Making of the English Working Class, 1963 (Preface)

quotes.quote: I am seeking to rescue the poor stockinger, the Luddite cropper ... from the enormous condescension of posterity.
quotes.source: The Making of the English Working Class, 1963

quotes.quote: The working class did not rise like the sun at an appointed time. It was present at its own making.
quotes.source: The Making of the English Working Class, 1963

quotes.quote: In every case the ruling ideas are ... the ideas of the ruling class.
It is not the consciousness of men that determines their being, but ... their social being that determines their consciousness.
quotes.source: A Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy, Preface, 1859

quotes.quote: The crisis consists precisely in the fact that the old is dying and the new cannot be born.
All men are intellectuals ... but not all men have in society the function of intellectuals.
Ideology represents the imaginary relationship of individuals to their real conditions of existence.
Ideology interpellates individuals as subjects.
Ideology has no history.
Culture today is infecting everything with sameness.
To write poetry after Auschwitz is barbaric.
Wrong life cannot be lived rightly.
That which withers in the age of mechanical reproduction is the aura of the work of art.
quotes.source: The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction, 1936

quotes.quote: There is no document of civilization which is not at the same time a document of barbarism.
quotes.source: Theses on the Philosophy of History, 1940

quotes.quote: This storm is what we call progress.
quotes.source: Theses on the Philosophy of History, 1940 (Angel of History)

quotes.quote: Myth is a type of speech.
Myth ... transforms history into nature.
The birth of the reader must be at the cost of the death of the Author.
The simulacrum is never that which conceals the truth - it is the truth which conceals that there is none.
quotes.source: Simulacra and Simulation, 1981 (epigraph attributed to Ecclesiastes)

quotes.quote: Disneyland is presented as imaginary in order to make us believe that the rest is real.
The desert of the real itself.
Taste classifies, and it classifies the classifier.
The spectacle is not a collection of images, but a social relation among people, mediated by images.
I define postmodern as incredulity toward metanarratives.
The medium is the message.
Popular culture is made by the people, not produced by the culture industry.
Societies are subject, every now and then, to periods of moral panic.
Style in subculture is ... pregnant with significance.
Popular culture is one of the sites where this struggle for and against a culture of the powerful is engaged.
Cultural identity ... is a matter of 'becoming' as well as of 'being'.
The subaltern cannot speak.
White men are saving brown women from brown men.
There is no gender identity behind the expressions of gender; that identity is performatively constituted.
One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.
Where there is power, there is resistance.
In a world ordered by sexual imbalance, pleasure in looking has been split between active/male and passive/female.
Ecocriticism is the study of the relationship between literature and the physical environment.
I would rather be a cyborg than a goddess.
Nation ... is an imagined political community.
Orientalism ... a Western style for dominating, restructuring, and having authority over the Orient.
The climate crisis is also a crisis of culture, and thus of the imagination.
